chunks: And it is narrated from Ḥadīd ibn Ḥakīm, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “A man buys hides from a butcher and gives him a known amount every day.” He said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.الْجُلُودَ: hides or skins being purchased in the transaction
key_terms.الْقَصَّابِ: the butcher from whom the hides are bought
key_terms.كُلَّ يَوْمٍ: every day, indicating repeated daily payment
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy hides from a butcher and pay a fixed amount each day?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling permitting a transaction in which a man buys hides from a butcher and pays a fixed known amount daily. Its significance is in indicating the permissibility of such an ongoing commercial arrangement when the amount is specified.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3940 - It is narrated from Hadid bin Hakim, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (as): "A man buys hides from a butcher and pays him a fixed amount every day."
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in that."
